title: WebGPU Deferred Shadow Mapping in Rust: 3x3 PCF with wgpu
description: Build deferred shadow mapping in WebGPU with Rust and wgpu: render animated Jax into three 1024x1024 depth maps and filter three spotlights with 3x3 PCF.
imageAlt: Animated rabbit-like Jax character casting overlapping colored spotlight shadows across a checkerboard floor.
